By [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> an '''assassination attempt''' was made against [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] who was the head of a [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|criminal empire]]. Jabba survived due to the actions of his loyal [[Majordomo/Legends|majordomo]], [[Sevan Domna]], who [[Death/Legends|sacrificed his life]].<ref name="VD" /> Jabba was eventually [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|killed]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The attempted assassination of Jabba Desilijic Tiure was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Visual Dictionary]]'', a reference book written by [[David West Reynolds (real person)|David West Reynolds]] and published in [[1998]].<ref name="VD" />
